UI_TWF_QOL_AIM_FLOOR_ATTACK_KEY_TT: Default: not assigned. When assigned, this key temporarily forces aim and manually targets floor attacks with your equipped primary weapon. The Vanilla 'Auto Detect Prone or Standing attack' option is automatically disabled while this QoL keybind is active.
UI_TWF_QOL_CAMPFUEL_ENABLE_TT: If enabled, uses the slider below instead of Sandbox rules.
UI_TWF_QOL_DKC_ENABLE_TT: Enable or disable the Daily Kill Count message.
UI_TWF_QOL_DKC_HALO_COLOR_TT: Sets the text color for the Daily Kill Count message.
UI_TWF_QOL_DKC_USE_US_DATE: Daily Kill Count: Use US date format
UI_TWF_QOL_DKC_USE_US_DATE_TT: If enabled, the date is shown as MM-DD-YYYY. <LINE> <LINE> If disabled, the default format is DD-MM-YYYY.
UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL: Double-click food eats the whole item
UI_TWF_QOL_FOOD_DBLCLICK_EATALL_TT: When enabled, double-clicking food uses the vanilla behavior and eats the whole item instead of smart partial eating.
UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_BETTERLIGHT_TT: Toggles Better Foraging Light. When disabled, vanilla search penalties and icons apply.
UI_TWF_QOL_FORAGING_IGNORE_COLLATERAL_SE: Singleplayer only. When enabled, wild crops found through foraging still give the food item, but the automatically generated extra seed items are ignored.
UI_TWF_QOL_INV_ICON_SCALE_TT: Scales item icons in inventory lists only. <LINE> <LINE> 100 = vanilla size, 200 = double size.
UI_TWF_QOL_INV_REORDER_ENABLE_TT: Reorder player containers by click, hold, and drag.
UI_TWF_QOL_INV_SHOWNAME: Show player name in inventory title
UI_TWF_QOL_INV_SHOWNAME_TT: Adds the player's name to the inventory title.
UI_TWF_QOL_MAINMENU_MUSIC: Main Menu Music / Ambient - RESTART REQUIRED
UI_TWF_QOL_MAINMENU_MUSIC_TT: If enabled, the main menu loops ambient sound and music. <LINE> <LINE> RESTART REQUIRED!
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_BELT_CLEA: Reload Key: Belt Cleanup + Auto Equip

Optional sub-feature. When the Reload key attaches a one-handed melee weapon to a Belt slot, broken duplicates of the same item type in the main inventory are dropped to the ground, then the newly attached belt weapon is equipped. Does not affect backpack contents or Back-slot weapons.
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_ENABLE: Reload Key: Attach Spare Melee Weapons
UI_TWF_QOL_MELEE_RELOAD_HOTBAR_ENABLE_TT: When enabled, the Reload key can attach spare carried melee weapons to free weapon slots. Short press attaches matching duplicates to free Back or Belt slots. Hold Reload to open a melee-only weapon radial menu. Firearms, fishing rods, and Vanilla weapon sharpening remain untouched.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_ENABLE_TT: When enabled, combat-stance movement speed uses the selected Nimble limit only if your real Nimble level is higher. XP is not reduced.
UI_TWF_QOL_NIMBLE_LIMIT_LEVEL_TT: Sets the maximum effective Nimble level for combat-stance movement speed. If your real Nimble level is equal or lower, nothing is changed.
UI_TWF_QOL_POPFACTOR_ENABLE_TT: Shows the current zombie population factor as a small UI element. Updates hourly.
UI_TWF_QOL_REMOVE_MAKEUP_TT: If enabled, washing yourself also removes character makeup.
UI_TWF_QOL_RIPALL_STOP_NO_ROOM: I can't carry any more clothing.
UI_TWF_QOL_RIPALL_STOP_NO_TOOL: I need usable scissors or a sharp knife to rip denim or leather.
UI_TWF_QOL_RIPALL_STOP_TOOL_DULL: My scissors or knife are too dull.
UI_TWF_QOL_RIPALL_STOP_TOO_DARK: It is too dark to rip denim or leather.
